_comment: When `setup.js` is folded into `main.js`, the chunk holding `effect.js` and `barrel.js` is still a separate import of the entry. `barrel.js` runs after `setup.js` but has no side effect of its own, and `effect.js`, whose side effect it reaches, ran before it, so the fold keeps every side effect in order. Judged by the module-level verdict alone, `barrel.js` would count as side-effectful and the fold would be vetoed; both chunks would then stay files.
